I’ve drafted a model, but it cannot yet responsibly answer the hiring choice.

- Your stated constraints are: ship by Q3 and keep annual salary spend under £400k.
- Its provisional first pass uses **Olumi estimates**, not your data: £110k per senior, £55k per junior, £180k existing annual salary spend, and 2 FTE-equivalent months/month delivery capacity.
- It also includes two comparison cases—current staffing and one senior plus one junior—but puts no option forward: the Q3 date, delivery scope, ramp-up and whether the cap includes existing payroll are unknown.

Which year and month does Q3 end, and does the £400k include current payroll?

The model was saved. Questions this model does not answer yet: Which calendar year does “Q3” refer to, and how many months remain until its end? Does the £400k annual salary-spend cap include existing staff payroll, or only the new hires? The provisional £180k existing-spend baseline is an AI modelling assumption. What are the actual fully loaded annual salaries for senior and junior engineers? The provisional assumptions are £110k and £55k respectively. What is the current platform delivery capacity, and how much capacity does each senior or junior hire add after ramp-up? The provisional capacity baseline of 2 FTE-equivalent months/month is an AI modelling assumption. What scope, remaining work, and minimum completion threshold are required to count the platform as shipped by Q3? (and 1 more)
